# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** Theology student and mission church pastor  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>; Reverend  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ezra  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is an extremely plain young man with a large, gangly frame and elongated legs. He has limp flaxen hair, unkempt on ordinary days, which covers a scholarly forehead. He also has green eyes, a large mouth, and large ears.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra possesses a beautiful, noble soul and nature. He is bright, gentle, serious, and deeply faithful to his calling, embodying what a clergyman should be. He enjoys laughing and joking, and radiates a charm that captivates others once he speaks with his delightful voice. Additionally, he provides thoughtful, practical advice to help others find clarity in their choices.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P17](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0017), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Goals

- Fulfill his divine calling as a clergyman to the best of his ability  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia and took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church over a summer. While at Prospect Point, he befriended Cressida (Cressy), taking her boating, fishing, and strolling along the shore, while also delivering a powerful sermon at the village church that deeply moved her. Although initially reluctant to join the ministry, he embraced it as his divine purpose. He gave Cressy a rule of thumb for making choices—to act as she would wish to have acted when eighty years old—and comfortably accepted her lighthearted nature. By the following spring, he finished his studies at St. Columbia and made plans to take over a small slum mission church on Tanner Street, with he and Cressy set to be married a year from the coming June.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)_

- Graduated from Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Quotes

> No, I was unable to. I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
